meta.name: theme-factory
meta.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为幻灯片、文档等作品一键套用或生成主题样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同文档或演示统一配色和字体风格
copy.tagline_en: Apply or generate themes for slides, docs, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need consistent colors and fonts across documents and presentations

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 可以给幻灯片、文档、报告等工件套用统一的配色和字体主题。它有 10 个预设主题，能先展示效果供你挑选，也能根据你的描述现场生成新主题并应用。
howto.when: 当你要给幻灯片、文档、报告等工件搭配配色或字体，或要求新建主题时触发。

say.text: 给这份幻灯片应用 Ocean Depths 主题。
say.note: 会读取对应主题文件并套用到整份幻灯片。

say.text: 先展示一下主题预览图。
为我的落地页生成一个科技感的新主题。
say.note: 会按描述创建新主题，展示审核后应用。

howto.what_en: With this skill installed, Claude can apply unified color and font themes to artifacts like slides, docs, and reports. It ships with 10 preset themes, can show them for preview, and can also generate and apply a custom theme on the fly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to apply a color/font theme to slides, docs, reports, or similar artifacts, or to create a new theme.

say_en.text: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this slide deck.
say_en.note: Reads the theme file and applies it across the deck.

say_en.text: Show me the theme showcase first.
say_en.note: Opens theme-showcase.pdf to display all themes.

say_en.text: Generate a tech-inspired theme for my landing page.
say_en.note: Creates a custom theme, shows it for review, then applies.
